title: Discord Join Call
blurb: The Discord join blip — the friendly two-note rise announcing someone has entered the call. An entire generation is now conditioned to respond to it by saying a name as a question, before the person has spoken. It's one of the most-heard sounds in modern online socialising, which is why it works so well out of context: play it mid-conversation and everyone glances at their taskbar. Use it in edits to signal an arrival, or in a real call to convince the group a ghost member just materialised.
